title: 30A Private Home with 3BRs and Two Shared Pools
meta_description: Stay at Grateful by the Sea, a 3BR, 2BA, 30A vacation home with a screened-in porch, minutes from the beach, and access to two pools. Sleeps 8.
description_expanded: Grateful by the Sea is a classic Florida beach home surrounded by lush trees and greenery with plenty of screened outdoor porch space to relax with a refreshing beverage. You're minutes to the beach and enjoy access to 2 neighborhood pools (+ tennis courts!) in the Grove By The Sea community.Walk in through the screened-in porch to find your open concept main area with warm hardwood floors, calming neutrals, and pops of coastal blues. The fully equipped kitchen overlooks the living and dining areas, making conversations and entertaining a breeze. 6 can sit at the bar top counter and there are 6 spots at the more formal dining table. Or, you can enjoy a dinner outside on the screened-in porch!The bedrooms are at the back of the home, sleeping 8 total. There are 2 king bedrooms, one with a private bathroom. The bunk room includes 2 sets of twin-over-twin bunks - a set up the kids in the group will surely enjoy! The shared hallway bathroom also includes a stacked washer and dryer - no need to overpack for this 30A vacation.With such a great location and amazing amenities of the Grove By The Sea community, we know you're going to find your new favorite beach home at Grateful by the Sea.Sleeping Arrangements:Bedroom 1: King bed, TV and outdoor access. Private bathroom with dual sinks, shower and jetted tub.Bedroom 2: King bed, TV.Bedroom 3: 2 sets of twin-over-twin bunks, TV.Bedrooms 2 and 3 share hallway bathroom with tub/shower combination.Beach Access:Head down N. Andalusia Ave. and follow this road across 30A and you’ll find your beach access.Distance: .3 miles | Time: 6 minutes walkingGrove By The Sea:As its name implies, The Grove by the Sea neighborhood is a peaceful, tree-lined community located directly across from the beautiful emerald beaches of South Walton. Beach access is an easy walk from the home, and there are 2 private neighborhood pools, plus a tennis court. Its proximity to nearby beach villages Seaside, Watercolor, Grayton Watersound, Alys and Rosemary make it an ideal location for all that 30A has to offer.30A:30A is a scenic stretch of highway down Florida’s beautiful Gulf Coast between Destin and Panama City Beach. The highway connects the coastal villages of South Walton through the undisturbed beauty of rare dune lakes, sugar white sand, and emerald waters indigenous to the area. Each village has its own unique characteristics that paint a fairytale-like scene against some of the country’s most beautiful beaches.Lined with artsy villages, coastal lakes, upscale resorts, eclectic beach bars, world-class restaurants and 25,000 acres of protected habitats, Florida's Scenic Highway 30A has something for everyone and is home to the world's most beautiful white sand beaches. Come see for yourself and we promise you will never want to leave.Your stay at Grateful By the Sea comes with Xplorie’s best activities! one ticket per day, per activity! (over $800 in nightly value) Tee off at Emerald Bay or Regatta Bay, zip through Baytowne Adventure Zone, and sail on the Sea Blaster Dolphin Cruise. Enjoy Big Kahuna’s Water Park, Black Light Mini Golf, and scenic bike rides with complimentary rentals. Explore 30A with ease and adventure!* Sorry, no pets allowed.* North pool in neighborhood is heated seasonally; please call for dates.* Parking for 2 cars.A Benchmark welcome bag and initial starter kit of amenities are provided for all guests. For the kitchen this includes: 1 roll of paper towels, 1 dish sponge, 1 dish soap, 2 dishwasher pods, and 1 liner for each trashcan. For each bathroom it includes: 1 roll of toilet paper, 1 set of soap/body wash/shampoo/conditioner/lotion. For towels you will receive: 1 body towel/1 washcloth per guest and 2 hand towels per bathroom, plus 2 washing machine pods.
